_comment: Which fixtures in this directory are a recording of the real read API, and which are hand-written. Read by `fixtures.test.ts`, which asserts each recorded one still equals the conformance golden (conformance/routes/read.json) — what the C# server is scored on. One list, so neither side can gain a fixture the other does not know about. A JSON file cannot carry a `# kit:` marker the way a corpus can, so membership is declared here instead — with a reason, never as a bare filename. ("generated" is the old name: the Node generator that wrote them is deleted, kit#153, and they are edited by hand together with the golden.)

generated.why: the list every corpus in the directory appears in — the fixture a new project changes
a real app's full projection, with every sharedWith empty
a real app's full projection whose nouns ARE shared, so sharedWith is exercised

handWritten.why: not a recording of anything — it is one half of a contract pinned from both sides, by ui/src/api/client.test.ts and by ui/src/test/contract.test.ts. Regenerating it would delete the pin.
